summary: Iter 21 - Verified BOM Builder re-edit dimension-preservation bug fix end-to-end via Playwright on the existing MP draft SA-260615-114115. Set known dims on all 3 items (Item1=10x20, Item2=15x25, Item3=7x14), opened Edit in BOM Builder, changed default qtys (500/1000/2500) AND pcs/set on row 0 (1->3), saved. After save: Item 1 = 10x20 PRESERVED, Item 2 = 15x25 PRESERVED, top-level qtys = [500,1000,2500,'',''] CORRECT, pcs/set row 0 = 3 CORRECT. Dim badges in the builder correctly reflect each row's per-item state (10x20, 15x25, 8.5x10.5). Core regression fix (existingState passed-through, freshItemState no longer wipes oneUpW/L) is WORKING. One edge-case observed: the CURRENTLY ACTIVE item's unsaved top-level edits are not snapshotted into bomItems[activeIdx].state before BOM Builder opens, so if user types dims and then clicks Edit-in-BOM-Builder without switching tabs first, the in-flight edits to the active item can be lost on save. Item 3 lost the just-typed 7x14 and reverted to its previously-persisted 8.5x10.5. Not part of the original review request scope (which focused on the wipe-everything bug), but worth flagging.

ui_bugs.issue: When opening 'Edit in BOM Builder' for the active item with UNSAVED top-level dim edits (oneUpW/L typed but no tab switch since), the prefill reads stale bomItems[activeIdx].state instead of gathering current top-level. On Save BOM the active item's in-flight edits are silently lost / reverted to last-persisted snapshot. Repro: edit Item 3 dims -> click Edit-in-BOM-Builder -> change qtys -> Save -> Item 3 dims revert.

action_items: Consider calling gatherItemState() and merging into bomItems[activeIdx].state when 'Edit in BOM Builder' is invoked (or in the modal's open-effect) so the currently active item's unsaved top-level edits are captured into _existingState before the prefill loop. See BomBuilderModal.jsx L49-81 and QuoteContext.jsx gatherItemState/switchBomItem pattern (L313-340).
critical_code_review_comments: BomBuilderModal.jsx L54-67 fix: correctly passes `_existingState: it.state || null` through draft rows on prefill. Verified live: 10x20 / 15x25 survive Save BOM after qty+pcs changes.

QuoteContext.jsx convertToMultiPart L522-545: correctly branches on row.existingState — preserves entire saved state and overrides only `qtys` (from opts.defaultQtys) and `itemDesc`. New-build path (row.existingState undefined) still calls freshItemState with shared seed fields. Code matches the fix description perfectly.

Edge case (not in fix scope): the active item's top-level oneUpW/L/etc are NOT mirrored into bomItems[activeItemIdx].state until the user switches BOM tabs. Opening BOM Builder bypasses that snapshot — recommend hooking BomSec.jsx's Edit button to first run a gatherItemState() sync, similar to switchBomItem's snap logic at QuoteContext.jsx L319-329.

success_rate.frontend: Bug fix re-save scenario: VERIFIED working for Items 1 & 2 (previously-persisted dims preserved). New BOM via templates was not retested in this iter but the convertToMultiPart code path with row.existingState=null is unchanged. Edge case: active item's unsaved edits lost (separate minor issue).

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: convertToMultiPart unconditionally called freshItemState({...seed, itemDesc}) for every draft row, blowing away oneUpW/L/qtys/rule inches across the entire BOM. Fix: BomBuilderModal now carries `_existingState: it.state` per draft row, passes it through onSaveBom as `existingState`, and convertToMultiPart now branches on row.existingState — preserving the full saved state object and overriding only qtys (from opts.defaultQtys if present) and itemDesc. Verified live: Items 1 & 2 dims survive Save BOM round-trip with default-qty changes AND pcs/set changes. Minor edge case noted above.
